newsitem.title: USA: Israel's Netanyahu arrives in U.S. for talks.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Netanyahu arrives in U.S. for talks.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu arrived in the United States on Sunday to meet with Jordan's King Hussein and to prepare for talks with President Bill Clinton on the Middle East peace process.

Netanyahu's first stop was a Minnesota hospital where Hussein is recovering from successful prostate surgery. He planned to travel to Washington later in the day for a meeting on Monday with Clinton at which U.S. officials were expected to present new proposals for the crisis-plagued region.

Netanyahu arrived at the airport near this medical centre city at 6:40 p.m. EDT (2240 GMT). Hussein had routine prostate surgery on Saturday at a Mayo Clinic hospital to remove a benign enlargement of the gland.
